subject: Revit: no paid Autodesk service; find an alternative
instruction: No need for the paid Autodesk Revit service. He is sure there is an alternative; find a way to read Revit (RVT) drawings without it.
note: Founder chat 22 Sep 2026. Research free/open deterministic options (e.g. open-source RVT readers, IFC export requests) under the drawing-reading work.
